title: BDR - Crescimento para Closer/Inside Sales
description:
A Yever nasceu com um propósito ousado: impulsionar e-commerces do Brasil com um checkout rápido, inteligente e desenhado para conversão. Somos uma fintech em pleno crescimento, movida por tecnologia, performance e um time que joga pra ganhar.

Aqui, cada detalhe importa — da experiência do cliente à performance do checkout. E por trás disso existe um time comercial que sabe conversar com maturidade, entende o jogo do e-commerce e transforma oportunidade em resultado todos os dias.

Agora chegou a sua hora de fazer parte dessa história.

Estamos buscando um(a) BDR Outbound com perfil de caça: alguém que gosta de prospectar, abrir portas, gerar conversas qualificadas e construir pipeline real. Se você quer mais do que um emprego — quer crescer de verdade — a Yever é o seu lugar.

Seu desafio como BDR Outbound:

Ser BDR Outbound na Yever não é só mandar mensagem e fazer volume.

É estratégia, ritmo e inteligência comercial: entender o ICP, mapear oportunidades, abordar com contexto e abrir conversas que avançam.

Você será responsável por:

  • Prospectar ativamente (cold WhatsApp, cold email, cold call e redes sociais) e gerar oportunidades novas diariamente.
  • Mapear contas (lojas Shopify e e-commerces com potencial) e identificar decisores.
  • Conduzir as primeiras conversas com clareza, velocidade e persuasão.
  • Diagnosticar rapidamente o momento da operação e as dores reais do lead (conversão, aprovação, checkout, escala).
  • Qualificar e agendar reuniões para os closers com contexto completo e alto padrão de qualidade.
  • Manter o CRM organizado e atualizado com informações estratégicas (histórico, objeções, timing e próximos passos).
  • Criar rotina de melhoria: testar abordagens, copiar o que funciona e ajustar o que não funciona.
  • Monitorar diariamente volume, conversão, taxa de resposta e qualidade de SQLs.
  • Dominar nosso produto, modelo de negócio e o cenário do e-commerce para vender com confiança.

Aqui você aprende rápido — e cresce mais rápido ainda.

Evolução: sua trilha para Inside Sales / Closer

Na Yever, a evolução para Inside Sales/Closer é clara e estruturada.

Com consistência e entrega, você passa a:

  • Conduzir o ciclo completo de vendas — da abordagem ao fechamento.
  • Fazer reuniões profundas, com visão de negócio e foco em métricas.
  • Apresentar soluções com base em dados e impacto real.
  • Negociar com maturidade e foco em valor (não desconto).
  • Acompanhar o início da operação dos clientes que você fecha, garantindo sucesso inicial.
  • Crescimento aqui não é discurso. É trilha, prática e realidade.

O que buscamos em você:

  • Experiência prévia como SDR/BDR Outbound, vendas consultivas ou atendimento comercial com metas.
  • Vontade genuína de crescer para Inside Sales/Closer — e fazer isso rápido.
  • Comunicação clara, escuta ativa e boa leitura de contexto.
  • Disciplina, cadência e consistência: você sabe que outbound é jogo de repetição bem feita.
  • Perfil analítico para acompanhar métricas e ajustar abordagem.
  • Energia, resiliência e postura de dono(a).
  • Digitação rápida e precisão na execução.
  • Compromisso real com metas, melhoria contínua e aprendizado constante.

O que oferecemos:

✅ Salário fixo + ajuda de custo: A combinar

✅ Plano de saúde Amil (após 6 meses)

✅ Gympass por nossa conta (após um ano)

✅ Mentoria direta com liderança comercial

✅ Ferramentas modernas para ganhar velocidade e escala

✅ Ambiente de aprendizado acelerado e cultura leve

✅ Escritório incrível no coração da Savassi (BH)

Aqui você tem autonomia, acesso direto aos fundadores e liberdade para criar, sugerir e evoluir.

Por que crescer na Yever?

  • Somos uma startup em expansão acelerada — se você cresce, a empresa cresce.
  • Atuamos no maior mercado do Brasil: e-commerce.
  • Cultura colaborativa, sem ego, com espaço real para quem entrega e aprende rápido.
  • Feedbacks constantes e evolução de verdade.
  • Você vai aprender com quem está no jogo — e subir de nível rápido.
  • Aqui, a gente trabalha, evolui, dá risada, deixa marca e faz história.

Ritual oficial da casa:

No seu primeiro dia, a gente almoça todo mundo junto.

Já sabe onde quer ir?

Pronto(a) para acelerar sua carreira na Yever?

Aqui você começa como BDR Outbound e pode chegar onde quiser — sem teto, sem limites, só evolução.

Vem construir essa história com a gente!

Sobre nós

Grupo Ponto da Educação nasceu do sonho de contribuir com o crescimento pessoal e profissional da comunidade de Lagoa da Prata e região. Desde o início, escolhemos caminhar ao lado da Unopar Anhanguera , instituições com tradição e inovação no ensino superior brasileiro.

Para chegarmos ao nosso propósito, nossos valores são o que nos motiva: levar educação de qualidade a mais pessoas e transformar realidades por meio do conhecimento. Queremos realizar sonhos, acreditamos que a educação transforma vidas, não é uma graduação, é um sonho, que graças ao ensino à distância se torna realidade para mais pessoas a cada dia.

Ao longo dos anos, construímos muito mais que um polo educacional – formamos um espaço de acolhimento, transformação e oportunidade. Acreditamos que cada aluno é único e merece ser acompanhado de perto, com empatia, respeito e compromisso. Nosso time é feito de pessoas que acreditam no poder da educação e que trabalham para fazer a diferença na vida dos alunos.

Hoje, seguimos em constante crescimento, buscando novas formas de inovar e atender ainda melhor nossos estudantes. Valorizamos um ambiente de trabalho colaborativo, humano e cheio de propósito – e é com esse espírito que estamos em busca de novos talentos que queiram construir essa história com a gente.

Sobre a sua Vaga

O Consultor Comercial desempenha um papel estratégico no crescimento e sustentabilidade da instituição, especialmente na captação ativa de alunos e até retenção. Seu principal objetivo é atrair novos alunos, apresentar os cursos da instituição, orientar e oferecer suporte aos candidatos durante o processo de matrícula, e contribuir para o cumprimento das metas de captação. Ele atua como ponte entre a universidade e os futuros estudantes.

Suas principais responsabilidades serão

  • Captação de Alunos: Prospecção ativa (ligações, visitas a escolas, feiras), atendimento de leads (interessados via site, redes sociais, WhatsApp), apresentação dos cursos, diferenciais e estrutura da instituição.

  • Pós-venda: Acompanhamento do processo de efetivação da matrícula e liberação do portal para estudos, fidelização garantindo uma boa experiência inicial do aluno com a universidade, trabalhar com o aluno para gerar novos leads.
  • Análise de Dados e Relatórios: Monitoramento de metas de matrícula, geração de relatórios de desempenho, sugestões para melhoria de campanhas de marketing e vendas.

Para esta posição, esperamos que você tenha

Será um diferencial se você

About the Team

At DoorDash, we’re on a mission to empower local economies — and that mission drives everything we do. What started as food delivery has evolved into a technology and logistics platform designed to help people access anything in their city, from meals to everyday essentials. We’re building the future of local commerce, and we’re looking for team members excited to be part of that journey.

Joining DoorDash means working in a fast-paced, dynamic environment where your ideas can shape products, impact millions of users, and help merchants, Dashers, and customers thrive. We value creativity, ownership, and continuous learning — and we’re committed to creating a workplace where everyone can grow their careers while making a real difference.

We also care deeply about our team’s well‑being. DoorDash offers comprehensive benefits, including premium healthcare, paid parental leave, wellness reimbursements, and more — because we believe that when our people thrive, our communities thrive too.

About the Role

You will lead a team of backend engineers responsible for the design and evolution of DoorDash’s Resolution Center platform. Your focus will be on building and scaling the systems that power Credits and Refunds, operational interventions, and resolution workflows across self‑help, chatbot, voicebot, and agent‑assisted channels.

You will partner closely with Product, Machine Learning, Fraud, Data Science, and Strategy & Operations to define and deliver a roadmap that integrates ML‑driven decisions, workflow orchestration, and strong configuration safeguards into high‑volume production systems. This platform directly influences cost, fraud exposure, and customer trust. You will own the technical direction and operational excellence required to run it at scale.

You're excited about this opportunity because you will…

  • Lead and grow a high‑performing team of backend engineers focused on Credits & Refunds, operational resolution workflows, and policy configuration systems.
  • Own the migration of resolution workflows to the unified stack, ensuring data continuity, reliability, and zero regression in production systems.
  • Partner with Machine Learning teams to productionize AI‑driven C&R models and integrate them safely into high‑volume workflows.
  • Shape the long‑term architecture of a decision engine that balances personalization, fraud prevention, and business guardrails.
  • Improve configuration safety by implementing validation tooling, staged rollouts, and guardrails to reduce operational risk.
  • Mentor engineers in distributed systems design, experimentation frameworks, and platform excellence.
  • Foster a culture of ownership, velocity, and strong cross‑functional collaboration.
  • Partner with Recruiting to build a diverse, inclusive, and high‑caliber engineering team.

We're excited about you because you have…

  • BS, M.S., or PhD. in Computer Science or related field
  • 2+ years of experience in people management, leading eading backend/platform teams of 5+ engineers
  • 7+ years of industry experience
  • Experience working with remote teams in different time zone(s) and fluency in English
  • Extensive experience as an engineer in a fast‑paced, product‑focused development environment
  • Experience with distributed system design, system scaling, and performance optimization
  • Hands‑on leadership and strong product intuition
  • Humility - willing to get into the details and open to feedback
  • Growth mindset - you're eager to expand your skill set and excited to carve out your career path in a hyper‑growth setting
  • Adaptability, resiliency, and ability to thrive in ambiguity - things can change quickly, and you'll need to help the team evolve

At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. About the Role

Commure is on the lookout for Software Engineers to join our Athelas Home Engineering team, playing a pivotal role in enhancing our FDA-cleared IoT medical device product. The Athelas Home is a portable device that segments and counts the hematology composition of an individual's blood. Our product captures high resolution imagery of a blood sample and utilizes an ML model to determine the concentration of white blood cells using a few drops of blood. Hardware, software, and chemistry come together in concert to produce a streamlined, efficient, and powerful diagnostics platform whose results are as accurate as gold-standard devices at a fraction of the cost. Today, these devices are deployed and active across the world, making bloodwork more comfortable for patients and more accessible for their doctors.

This position is perfect for someone who has experience with full stack software engineering; enjoys building new features and improving infrastructure, and has an interest in the medical device R&D space. You’ll be working in a small multi-functional engineering team comprised of chemical and hardware engineering, manufacturing, and quality.

What You'll Do

  • Development of existing backend and frontend services for the Athelas device product: improving our infrastructure, architecting and building robust, scalable back-end service
  • Translate product requirements into technical solutions
  • Implementation of cybersecurity best practices throughout the software development lifecycle
  • Collaborate with engineering, operations, quality, and regulatory functions to ensure that production software systems meet both operational, security, and regulatory requirements
  • Utilize a stack comprising Python, Flask, React, Postgres, Kubernetes, Docker
  • Apply problem-solving and analytical skills to diagnose and resolve technical issues efficiently, ensuring the stability and performance of our systems
  • Establish and enforce best practices for code quality, testing, and deployment

What You Have

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent extensive experience required
  • 4+ years of professional software engineering experience required, proficiency in Python
  • Deep expertise in developing and managing data pipelines and experience with PostgreSQL or similar relational database management systems
  • Advanced knowledge in Containerization and Cloud Services (Docker, Kubernetes)
  • A strategic thinker with a builder’s mindset, passionate about high-impact projects
  • Demonstrated expertise in building, scaling, and maintaining sophisticated production environments
  • Advanced skills in system monitoring, alerting, reporting, metrics tracking, and software reliability engineering
  • An exceptional sense of product development with a keen focus on user experience and customer needs
  • A commitment to ongoing personal and professional development

Nice To Have

  • Experience or interest in embedded software engineering – developing application software for embedded systems (Linux-based IoT medical device). Experience with hardware interfaces (GPIO, camera control, serial communication) and embedded Linux systems is a plus, though not required. Note: This is application software development on embedded hardware, not low-level firmware engineering.
  • Experience or interest in the design, training, and optimization of computer vision models for blood diagnostics, including object detection and classification models. Work across the ML lifecycle from data preparation and model training to deployment and performance monitoring.

Somos a Santa Casa de Porto Alegre, um complexo hospitalar com oito hospitais e mais de duzentos anos de história. Referência nacional e internacional nas áreas de cardiologia, cirurgia cardiovascular, transplantes, neurocirurgia, pneumologia, cirurgia torácica, oncologia e pediatria de alta complexidade. A cada ano, atendemos mais de 1 milhão de pessoas de todos os estados brasileiros e de 490 municípios gaúchos.

Com nossos mais de 10.000 profissionais , estamos fazendo história e ajudando a criar um mundo em que todas as pessoas tenham acesso à saúde de qualidade. Diariamente, circulam mais de 25 mil pessoas pelos nossos corredores e, com humanidade, acolhimento, compaixão, ética, carinho, respeito e amor, fazemos a diferença na vida de todas elas.

Diversidade e Inclusão são primordiais para a Santa Casa, isso porque somos muitos – em quantidade, em diferenças e em igualdades. Somos multiplicidade. Mas também somos humanidade. Somos indivíduos plurais em um propósito singular. Somos todos Santa Casa. Desta forma, SOMOS é o nome atribuído ao programa de Diversidade e Inclusão da Santa Casa.

Nossa cultura do acolher, cuidar e conviver está presente em todos nossos hospitais: Hospital Santa Clara, Hospital São Francisco, Pavilhão Pereira Filho, Hospital São José, Hospital Santa Rita, Hospital Dom Vicente Scherer, Hospital da Criança Santo Antônio (em Porto Alegre) e Hospital Dom João Becker (em Gravataí/RS). Também integram a Santa Casa as unidades de Atenção Primária à Saúde (APS), Unidade Pronto Atendimento (UPA), Casa de Apoio Madre Ana , o Centro Histórico-Cultural e o Cemitério Santa Casa .

A Santa Casa de Porto Alegre une tradição, inovação, história, cultura, ensino e pesquisa. Vamos juntos fazer a diferença na vida das pessoas?

This is a key role and ideal for someone who thinks strategically, enjoys fast-paced environments, passionate about making product decisions, and has experience building great user experiences that delight users.

  • Excellent communication skills
  • User oriented problem solving approach

Bonus:

  • Experience building, maintaining, or otherwise contributing to open source projects in Android

Technologies we use:

  • Kotlin
  • Kotlin Coroutines
  • Kotlin Flow
  • Jetpack Navigation
  • Dagger 2
  • Room
  • Custom Views, Canvas & Paint
  • Jetpack Compose

description:
Última atualização: 5 de fevereiro de 2026

A Casa Hacker é uma organização da sociedade civil de educação STEAM e inovação social. Nossa Teoria da Mudança coloca todo nosso team e parceiros técnicos, conhecimento e nossa rede para inovar, criando e co-criando iniciativas de educação STEAM e inclusão digital para tornar as tecnologias digitais e a Internet acessíveis para todos, considerando este contexto, a Casa Hacker investe em programas de inovação nos territórios em que atua e busca profissionais com experiência comprovada para liderar a estratégia conosco.

Na Casa Hacker, nossos eventos são conectados aos nossos programas e se tornem um ponto de conexão vital com a nossa comunidade e os territórios onde atuamos. Buscamos um(a) Gerente de Eventos que transforme objetivos institucionais em experiências memoráveis Seu papel é garantir que, do convite ao cafézinho final, tudo funcione de forma impecável, permitindo que os participantes foquem no aprendizado e na troca de saberes.

Principais Responsabilidades e Desafios

  • Planejar e executar o calendário de eventos para o semestre, alinhando objetivos, formatos e orçamentos com as gerências.
  • Gerenciar o orçamento disponível para cada iniciativa, negociando com fornecedores para garantir a melhor alocação de recursos e custo-benefício.
  • Definir cronogramas de produção (pré, durante e pós-evento), delegando tarefas quando necessário e monitorando prazos críticos.
  • Coordenar e/ou supervisionar toda a infraestrutura contratada e locada: locação de espaços, audiovisual, catering, cenografia, recepção, segurança e materiais de apoio.
  • Gerenciar a “experiência do participante”: inscrições, credenciamento, comunicação pré-evento e acolhimento no dia.
  • Atuar na resolução rápida de problemas e imprevistos durante a execução dos eventos.
  • Articular parcerias locais para fornecimento de serviços, fortalecendo a rede de empreendedores do território sempre que possível.

O que você traz na bagagem (requisitos)

  • Vivência sólida (3+ anos) na produção e gestão de eventos, preferencialmente em contextos de tecnologia, inovação ou educação.
  • Capacidade de cotar, negociar e gerir múltiplos fornecedores simultaneamente.
  • Domínio de plataformas de gestão de eventos (Sympla), ferramentas de reunião online (Meet) e planilhas de controle financeiro.
  • Excelente comunicação, alta capacidade de organização, atenção aos detalhes e proatividade. É essencial ter disponibilidade para trabalhar em horários comerciais (finais de semana nos dias exatos dos eventos), conforme a agenda de eventos.

Tempo e dedicação

  • Meio período, 30 horas semanais para a gestão e produção dos eventos, com necessidade de disponibilidade para trabalhar aos finais de semana e horários noturnos em dias de eventos.
  • Contratação pessoa jurídica (CNAE: 7020-4/00);
  • Remuneração fixa contratual – a partir de R$ 3.000,00~4.000,00/mês (o valor exato dependerá da experiência do candidato(a));
  • Remoto + Presencial (presencial nos dias de eventos e visita técnica, as demais atividades são realizáveis remotamente)

Compromisso com Diversidade, Equidade e Inclusão

A Casa Hacker acredita no valor da pluralidade de saberes e vivências, e reconhece que a diversidade, a equidade e a inclusão são fundamentais para enriquecer nossa missão. Encorajamos fortemente a candidatura de todas as pessoas, especialmente aquelas pertencentes a grupos historicamente marginalizados, incluindo (mas não se limitando a) mulheres, pessoas negras e indígenas, pessoas com deficiência e pessoas de todas as orientações sexuais, identidades e expressões de gênero.

Garantimos que pessoas com deficiência terão as adaptações e recursos de acessibilidade necessários para participar de qualquer etapa do processo seletivo ou entrevista, bem como para desempenhar suas funções essenciais. Caso necessite de algum recurso específico de acessibilidade, nos informe ao enviar sua candidatura.

Somos uma organização que preza pela igualdade de oportunidades. Não discriminamos com base em raça ou cor (incluindo características estéticas e textura do cabelo), religião/crença, gênero, identidade ou expressão de gênero, origem nacional, gravidez, ancestralidade, estado civil, deficiência, orientação sexual, idade, condições de saúde ou qualquer outra. A Casa Hacker não tolera discriminação ou assédio baseados em qualquer uma dessas características.

Se você tem perfil organizado, gosta de apoiar iniciativas de impacto social e deseja contribuir com a missão da Casa Hacker, envie seu LinkedIn e uma breve apresentação para com o assunto Gerente de Eventos .

title: UFPB oferta 180 bolsas para o Programa de Apoio às Licenciaturas
description:
Poderão se inscrever estudantes regularmente matriculados e frequentando um curso de licenciatura presencial ou à distância (Foto: Freepik)

A Pró-reitoria de graduação (PRG) da Universidade Federal da Paraíba (UFPB) publicou, nesta quinta-feira (23), o edital de seleção de projetos vinculados ao Programa de Apoio às Licenciaturas da UFPB (Prolicen), para execução em 2024. Como visto pelo ClickPB, serão ofertadas 180 bolsas no valor de R$ 700 para estudantes que participarem dos projetos escolhidos. Confira oedital .

O prazo para inscrição e submissão dos projetos será do dia 30 de novembro a 10 de dezembro pelo Sistema Integrado de Gestão de Eventos (SIGEventos), conforme orientações do edital nº 27 da Coordenação de Programas e de Projetos Acadêmicos (CPPA/PRG).

A submissão dos projetos somente pode ser realizada pelo docente coordenador, que deve ser do quadro efetivo da UFPB, possuir título de mestre ou doutor e não estar em licença ou afastamento. Os projetos podem envolver a participação de docentes de diferentes Departamentos ou Centros de Ensino.

O Prolicen busca selecionar projetos destinados à melhoria da qualidade dos cursos de licenciatura da Universidade por meio da aproximação entre os estudantes e escolas públicas, por meio de ações que articulem a relação entre teoria e prática e cooperem para formação inicial de professores da educação básica.

As propostas serão avaliadas e selecionadas por uma comissão. Serão aprovadas aquelas que obtiverem média final igual ou superior a 7,0 considerando 04 aspectos: relevância, qualidade, exequibilidade (viabilidade de execução dentro do prazo definido pelo edital) e abrangência (se envolve professores de departamentos e centros diferentes).

Os projetos selecionados serão divulgados, após recursos, em 15 de fevereiro.

Seleção de bolsistas

Uma segunda etapa prevista no edital é a seleção dos 180 bolsistas, que receberão o valor de R$ 700por 8 meses de atuação do projeto. Os bolsistas que atuarão nos projetos aprovados serão selecionados pelos respectivos professores coordenadores, com inscrições previstas para o período entre os dias 16 e 21 de fevereiro.

Poderão se inscrever estudantes regularmente matriculados e frequentando um curso de licenciatura presencial ou à distância, que tenham Coeficiente de Rendimento Acadêmico (CRA) igual ou superior a 7,0 e disponibilidade de 20 horas semanais, e não receba outra bolsa da instituição, exceto as de assistência estudantil.

As atividades do Programa, que são gerenciadas pela Coordenação de Programas e de Projetos Acadêmicos (CPPA/PRG), terão início em 1º de março. Dúvidas sobre o edital podem ser esclarecidas pelo e-mail , ou pelo telefone .

title: Software Engineer, Athelas Home
description:
At Commure, our mission is to simplify healthcare. We have bold ambitions to reimagine the healthcare experience, setting a new standard for how care is delivered and experienced across the industry. Our growing suite of AI solutions spans ambient AI clinical documentation, provider copilots, autonomous coding, revenue cycle management and more — all designed for providers & administrators to focus on what matters most: providing care.

Healthcare is a $4.5 trillion industry with more than $500 billion spent annually on administrative costs, and Commure is at the heart of transforming it. We power over 500,000 clinicians across hundreds of care sites nationwide – more than $10 billion flows through our systems and we support over 100 million patient interactions. With new product launches on the horizon, expansion into additional care segments, and a bold vision to tackle healthcare's most pressing challenges, our ambition is to move from upstart innovator to the industry standard over the next few years.

Commure was recently named to Fortune’s Future 50 list for 2025 and is backed by world-class investors including General Catalyst, Sequoia, Y Combinator, Lux, Human Capital, 8VC, Greenoaks Capital, Elad Gil, and more. Commure has achieved over 300% year-over-year growth for the past two years and this is only the beginning. Healthcare's moment for AI-powered transformation is here, and we're building the technology to power it. Come join us in shaping the future of healthcare.

About the Role

Commure is on the lookout for Software Engineers to join our Athelas Home Engineering team, playing a pivotal role in enhancing our FDA-cleared IoT medical device product. The Athelas Home is a portable device that segments and counts the hematology composition of an individual's blood. Our product captures high resolution imagery of a blood sample and utilizes an ML model to determine the concentration of white blood cells using a few drops of blood. Hardware, software, and chemistry come together in concert to produce a streamlined, efficient, and powerful diagnostics platform whose results are as accurate as gold‑standard devices at a fraction of the cost. Today, these devices are deployed and active across the world, making bloodwork more comfortable for patients and more accessible for their doctors.

This position is perfect for someone who has experience with full stack software engineering; enjoys building new features and improving infrastructure, and has an interest in the medical device R&D space. You’ll be working in a small multi‑functional engineering team comprised of chemical and hardware engineering, manufacturing, and quality.

What You’ll Do

  • Development of existing backend and frontend services for the Athelas device product: improving our infrastructure, architecting and building robust, scalable back‑end service
  • Translate product requirements into technical solutions
  • Implementation of cybersecurity best practices throughout the software development lifecycle
  • Collaborate with engineering, operations, quality, and regulatory functions to ensure that production software systems meet both operational, security, and regulatory requirements
  • Utilize a stack comprising Python, Flask, React, Postgres, Kubernetes, Docker
  • Apply problem‑solving and analytical skills to diagnose and resolve technical issues efficiently, ensuring the stability and performance of our systems
  • Establish and enforce best practices for code quality, testing, and deployment

What You Have

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent extensive experience required
  • 4+ years of professional software engineering experience required, proficiency in Python
  • Deep expertise in developing and managing data pipelines and experience with PostgreSQL or similar relational database management systems
  • Advanced knowledge in Containerization and Cloud Services (Docker, Kubernetes)
  • A strategic thinker with a builder’s mindset, passionate about high‑impact projects
  • Demonstrated expertise in building, scaling, and maintaining sophisticated production environments
  • Advanced skills in system monitoring, alerting, reporting, metrics tracking, and software reliability engineering
  • An exceptional sense of product development with a keen focus on user experience and customer needs
  • A commitment to ongoing personal and professional development

Nice To Have

  • Experience or interest in embedded software engineering – developing application software for embedded systems (Linux‑based IoT medical device). Experience with hardware interfaces (GPIO, camera control, serial communication) and embedded Linux systems is a plus, though not required. Note: This is application software development on embedded hardware, not low‑level firmware engineering.
  • Experience or interest in the design, training, and optimization of computer vision models for blood diagnostics, including object detection and classification models. Work across the ML lifecycle from data preparation and model training to deployment and performance monitoring.

Commure is committed to creating and fostering a diverse team. We are open to all backgrounds and levels of experience, and believe that great people can always find a place. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to all applicants throughout the application process.

Please be aware that all official communication from us will come exclusively from email addresses ending in @getathelas.com, @commure.com or @augmedix.com. Any emails from other domains are not affiliated with our organization.

Employees will act in accordance with the organization’s information security policies, to include but not limited to protecting assets from unauthorized access, disclosure, modification, destruction or interference nor execute particular security processes or activities. Employees will report to the information security office any confirmed or potential events or other risks to the organization. Employees will be required to attest to these requirements upon hire and on an annual basis.

description:
Assistente de Laboratório – Central de Atendimento

Você é uma pessoa organizada, atenta aos detalhes e que gosta de rotina e processos bem definidos? Tem foco no cliente e busca atuar em um ambiente colaborativo, com propósito e qualidade? Então, essa vaga pode ser para você!

Diferencial:

  • Formação técnica ou superior na área da saúde (concluída ou em andamento);
  • Experiência anterior em atendimento na área da saúde e/ou coleta.

1. Quem buscamos

  • Profissionais com perfil analítico e planejador, que valorizam organização, padronização e melhoria contínua.
  • Pessoas que gostam de trabalhar com sistemas, processos e atendimento ao cliente interno e externo.
  • Colaboradores responsáveis, colaborativos e com boa gestão de prioridades.

2. O que você vai fazer

  • Realizar atendimento ativo e receptivo aos clientes, acompanhando solicitações até o desfecho.
  • Monitorar pendências, atrasos e urgências de exames, garantindo tratativas ágeis.
  • Registrar, acompanhar e analisar interações, reclamações e não conformidades do atendimento.
  • Apoiar a gestão do setor, contribuindo com relatórios, indicadores e melhorias de processo.
  • Interagir com áreas técnicas e administrativas para solução de demandas.

3. O que oferecemos

  • Vale Alimentação/Refeição;
  • Seguro de vida.
  • Vale Transporte;
  • Plano de Saúde Unimed Unipart (coparticipativo);
  • Plano odontológico OdontoPrev ou Rede Dental;
  • TotalPass para bem-estar e saúde física;
  • Telemedicina: Clude Saúde com atendimento médico virtual gratuito (psicólogo, pronto atendimento e nutricionista);
  • Day Off: uma folga no mês do aniversário;
  • Clube de Descontos: parceria com faculdades e escola de idiomas.

>> Ambiente acolhedor, colaborativo e com foco em excelência no atendimento.

>> Oportunidade de desenvolvimento em um laboratório de referência.

4. Requisitos

  • Desejável formação técnica ou superior na área da saúde (concluída ou em andamento).
  • Desejável experiência em atendimento ao cliente, preferencialmente na área da saúde ou laboratório.
  • Conhecimento básico a intermediário em Excel.
  • Diferencial: experiência em laboratório de análises clínicas ou coleta.

5. Horário de trabalho

Segunda a quinta de 07h às 17h | Sexta de 07h às 16h

6. Quem somos:

Fundado em 2000, O Lab Rede é um tradicional laboratório do mercado de medicina diagnóstica, com atuação exclusiva no segmento de apoio – Lab to Lab.

Reconhecido pela qualidade e capacitação técnica, é referência em uma ampla gama de exames em especialidades, tais como: Imunologia, Hormônios, Bioquímica, Alergia, Autoimunidade, Genética, Biologia Molecular, Técnicas Manuais e Especiais, dentre outras.

Através de seu Núcleo Técnico Operacional (NTO), localizado em Belo Horizonte/MG, atende a inúmeros laboratórios nas regiões sudeste e centro-oeste do país, realizando exames com a mais alta tecnologia, de forma ágil e em condições competitivas.

Como laboratório exclusivo de Apoio, disponibiliza aos seus clientes uma equipe de profissionais altamente qualificados, aptos a oferecer toda a assistência científica e suporte técnico requeridos. Dessa forma, está sempre na posição de parceiro dos seus clientes.

Se você valoriza organização, proatividade e gosta de enfrentar desafios, envie seu currículo agora mesmo e venha fazer parte da nossa equipe!

Responsabilidades da Oportunidade

Overview

Como é o ambiente de trabalho? Na Fundação Educandário, o trabalho é conduzido com propósito, método e colaboração . O ambiente combina autonomia com apoio constante, permitindo que cada profissional exerça suas funções com clareza de metas e foco em resultados.

O(a) Gerente de Desenvolvimento Institucional contará com estrutura completa para desempenhar suas atividades, incluindo notebook e celular corporativos, além de custeio integral das despesas relacionadas à captação, como deslocamentos, hospedagens, eventos e reuniões estratégicas.

A rotina é presencial em Ribeirão Preto , com interação direta com a Diretoria Executiva e integração constante com as equipes de Comunicação, Projetos e Financeiro. O clima é de confiança e corresponsabilidade, todos trabalham com objetivos comuns e métricas claras de desempenho , num contexto em que os resultados sociais importam tanto quanto os números financeiros.

O profissional contará ainda com apoio de uma pessoa dedicada às rotinas operacionais e administrativas de captação , possibilitando que seu foco esteja nas atividades estratégicas, de relacionamento e na execução prática da captação de recursos.

Sobre a Fundação Educandário

Sobre a Fundação Educandário “Cel. Quito Junqueira” foi criada em 1938 com um propósito que segue guiando todas as nossas ações: transformar de forma permanente a vida de crianças e adolescentes em vulnerabilidade social.

Com 87 anos de história, somos hoje uma instituição que democratiza o acesso à educação e à cultura de qualidade, atendendo mais de 2.200 alunos, formando anualmente 650 profissionais da rede pública e recebendo 180 mil visitas por ano em nossas iniciativas culturais.

Atuamos em quatro frentes principais

  • Colégio Camillo de Mattos: oferece educação infantil e ensino fundamental integral, com 700 alunos atendidos gratuitamente.
  • Escolas Municipais Dr. Fábio dos Santos Musa e Geny Biagioni Veiga: geridas pela Fundação via Parceria Público- Privada, atendem mais de 1.500 crianças da educação infantil, com nutrição, uniformes, material escolar e atividades de desenvolvimento integral.
  • Biblioteca Sinhá Junqueira: espaço cultural vivo de Ribeirão Preto, com mais de 180 mil visitantes anuais e uma agenda de palestras, oficinas, shows e exposições.
  • Programa de Formação de Profissionais da Rede Pública: capacita gestores e professores de 102 escolas em 14 municípios, impactando 65 mil alunos por ano, com base em práticas de gestão escolar, equidade e melhoria da aprendizagem.

Sobre a vaga

Buscamos uma pessoa com experiência sólida e comprovada em captação de recursos , disposta a assumir papel protagonista na sustentabilidade e expansão dos projetos da Fundação.

Trata-se de uma posição estratégica, mas também de execução prática: o(a) Gerente de Desenvolvimento Institucional será a principal liderança responsável por garantir o financiamento das ações da Fundação, tanto na manutenção quanto na ampliação dos programas existentes e futuros.

Principais responsabilidades

  • Entre as responsabilidades: Elaborar e executar o plano operacional de captação de recursos, com metas claras de curto, médio e longo prazo.
  • Conduzir todas as etapas práticas de captação, desde a prospecção de doadores e empresas parceiras até a formalização de parcerias, renovações e prestação de contas.
  • Coordenar a escrita, submissão e acompanhamento de projetos em editais públicos e privados, nacionais e internacionais.
  • Ampliar a captação via leis de incentivo e destinação de recursos públicos (como ICMS, CONDECA, PRONON, PROAC e outros).
  • Desenvolver e manter relacionamento com grandes doadores, fundações empresariais e investidores sociais, atuando com visão de longo prazo e alto padrão de entrega.
  • Atuar em conjunto com as áreas de Comunicação, Projetos e Financeiro para integrar narrativa institucional, resultados e transparência, fortalecendo a reputação e credibilidade da Fundação.
  • Desenvolver materiais e apresentações institucionais personalizados para diferentes perfis de doadores.
  • Monitorar indicadores de desempenho, reportar resultados e propor ajustes estratégicos.
  • Representar a Fundação em reuniões, eventos e fóruns relevantes do terceiro setor e de responsabilidade social corporativa.

Descrição da empresa

A Eurofins Scientific é uma empresa internacional de ciências da vida, fornecendo uma gama exclusiva de serviços de testes analíticos para clientes em vários setores, para tornar a vida e o ambiente mais seguros, saudáveis e sustentáveis. Desde os alimentos que você come, até a água que você bebe, e os medicamentos nos quais você confia, a Eurofins trabalha com as maiores empresas do mundo para garantir que os produtos fornecidos sejam seguros, seus ingredientes autênticos e a rotulagem exata. A Eurofins acredita que é líder global em testes de produtos alimentícios, ambientais, farmacêuticos e cosméticos e em serviços de agrociência CRO. É também um dos líderes mundiais independentes de mercado em determinados serviços de testes e laboratório para genômica, farmacologia de descoberta, forense, CDMO, ciências avançadas de materiais e no apoio a estudos clínicos.

Em apenas 30 anos, a Eurofins cresceu de um laboratório em Nantes, França, para mais de 47.000 funcionários em uma rede de mais de 900 empresas independentes em mais de 50 países e operando mais de 800 laboratórios. A Eurofins oferece um portfólio de mais de 200.000 métodos analíticos para avaliar a segurança, identidade, composição, autenticidade, origem, rastreabilidade e pureza de substâncias e produtos biológicos, além de fornecer serviços inovadores de testes de diagnóstico clínico, como um dos principais players emergentes globais em teste de diagnóstico clínico especializado.

Em 2019, a Eurofins gerou receita total de EUR 4,56 bilhões e está entre as ações com melhor desempenho na Europa nos últimos 20 anos.

Descrição do emprego

Orientar os assistentes, auxiliares e estagiários. Executar as técnicas analíticas descritas nos procedimentos da empresa, com análise crítica dos resultados, atendendo aos prazos, mantendo a organização e zelando pela segurança e integridade de todos.

  • Auxiliar na checagem de resultados analíticos / análises críticas;
  • Executar os ensaios de proficiência;
  • Comunicar qualquer problema na rotina ou necessidade de materiais ao Analista Sênior ou Coordenador da área;
  • Auxiliar no envio de materiais para calibração;
  • Organizar o laboratório para o preparo de materiais (soluções, tampões, meios de cultura, soluções padrão), checagem de temperaturas, validade das soluções e reagentes em uso;
  • Orientar constantemente o time para limpeza e organização das áreas com foco em segurança no laboratório;
  • Incluir os resultados avaliados, repetições e análises adicionais no sistema Lims, bem como registrar informações pertinentes;
  • Realizar a solicitação de compra de materiais para o laboratório no sistema com supervisão do Analista Sênior ou Coordenação, se necessário;

  • Segregar e descartar os resíduos.

title: F&B Concessions Coordinator
description:
Department

Tournament and Venue Operations

Location

Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

The Position

Working alongside the FIFA/FIFA27 Partnership Rights Delivery (PRD) team and reporting to the FIFA Senior Partner Rights Delivery Manager in Zurich and the FIFA27 Senior F&B Concessions Manager, the F&B Concessions Coordinator supports the operational planning and delivery of the Public Food and Beverage (F&B) Concessions Programme for stadium spectators and fulfillment of FIFA’s Commercial Partners’ contractual rights and obligations across all stadiums at the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™. The objective is to implement and deliver successfully the FIFA Commercial Partners’ exclusive food & beverage rights. This position plays an integral part in ensuring a successful tournament through the delivery of FIFA’s commercial operations in the host country. The role operates under the supervision of the FIFA Senior Partner Rights Delivery Manager and the FIFA27 Senior F&B Concessions Manager and does not carry direct commercial ownership or decision‑making authority over F&B concessionaire or Commercial Partner agreements.

Key Responsibilities

  • The main responsibilities of the F&B Concessions Coordinator for the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™ encompass supporting the planning, coordination, and operational delivery of the F&B Concessions Programme, including but not limited to:
  • Support the implementation of the Public F&B Concessions Programme across all eight stadiums, including timeline tracking, milestone follow‑up, and coordination of deliverables.
  • Assist in integrating Commercial Partner products and services within the F&B Concessions Programme.
  • Support the planning and operational implementation of the commercial rights granted to FIFA’s Commercial Partners within the F&B Concessions Programme.
  • Coordinate with appointed F&B Concessionaire(s), service providers, and internal stakeholders to ensure smooth information flow and execution of services within the F&B Concessions project.
  • Provide administrative and organisational support throughout the F&B concessionaire tender (RFP) and other related F&B related tender processes, including documentation management, evaluation support, reporting and assistance in market research activities.
  • Support the review, mapping, preparation, and optimisation of onsite F&B infrastructure and facilities across all official stadiums, ensuring proper documentation and tracking of action points.
  • Track the development and implementation of F&B concepts and operations, menus, pricing, and onsite infrastructure across all stadiums, ensuring deadlines and requirements are met.
  • Coordinate logistics and administrative preparation for stadium inspections and Commercial Partner operational F&B site visits, preparing documentation and follow‑up actions.
  • Support the creation and coordination of F&B-related signage and branding elements (e.g. menu boards).
  • Assist in defining and optimising the service and display of F&B Commercial Partners’ products, supporting alignment between internal and external stakeholders.
  • Prepare reports, presentations, dashboards, and tracking tools using Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Teams, etc.).
  • Assist in developing and maintaining training materials, briefing documents, presentations and operational guidelines.
  • Assist with monitoring daily operations pre‑tournament and during tournament time, ensuring proper documentation and reporting.

Your Profile

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Catering, Hospitality Management, Event Management, Business Administration, or a related field (or equivalent level of education).

Experience

  • 2 - 4 years of professional experience in food & beverage, catering, hospitality, event management, or a related area.
  • Experience supporting F&B concessions or catering operations, ideally within large‑scale international events, preferably in the sports industry.
  • Exposure to project coordination and administrative support within complex, multi‑stakeholder environments.
  • Experience assisting in infrastructure or operational planning is considered an asset.

Skills & Competencies

  • Good understanding of the food & beverage concessions industry; experience in stadium or event environments is an advantage.
  • Basic knowledge of utilities and infrastructure requirements relevant to F&B operations (e.g. electricity, water supply).
  • Understanding of food safety and hygiene standards applicable to F&B operations.
  • Strong organisational and coordination skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities simultaneously.
  • Structured working style with high attention to detail and strong follow‑up capabilities.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in a team environment and under tight timelines.
  • Proactive and solution‑oriented mindset with a service‑focused approach to commercial rights delivery.

Certification & Requirements

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office tools (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Teams; knowledge of Visio and MS Project is an advantage).
  • Experience using planning software and online collaboration tools.
  • Willingness to travel and work extended hours during peak project phases and tournament time.

Candidate Requirements

  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Bilingual – Portuguese and English.
  • Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro for the duration of the employment (pre‑tournament and operational tournament time).

MonetizeMore is a global leader in ad tech, seen by 300M+ people monthly. For 16 years, we’ve achieved double-digit growth by blending proprietary AI technology with manual optimization techniques to empower publishers. We are a culture-centric, location-independent organization that values Integrity, Enterprising, Kaizen, and Collaboration.

MonetizeMore offers location and schedule freedom to every one of its team members. That means that you would have the lifestyle autonomy to choose to work from anywhere in the world, during the time of day you prefer. This new-age work lifestyle would enable you to engineer your ideal lifestyle. Say goodbye to endless commutes, stuffy business attire, and the arbitrary 9 to 5 work-day. Take your life back into your hands by joining the MonetizeMore team!

What You’ll Do

As part of our Publisher Centric Team , At M2, we focus and emphasize proactive Publisher Services. As the Onboarding Manager, your role is a critical "first impression" of our organization and our ability to support our publishing partners in reaching their goals.

You will spearhead the onboarding process for new publishers, ensuring they are equipped with the right tech, knowledge, and confidence to succeed. You are not just setting up accounts you are orchestrating a "White Glove" experience that reduces time-to-value and sets the stage for long-term retention. You also pay attention to improving our systems and processes along the way to continuously improve our service to publishers.

Responsibilities

  1. Project Management & Implementation
    • Lead the Lifecycle: Expertly manage the publisher journey from Sales endorsement to "Live" status. You are the project manager for the publisher’s first 30-90 days.
    • Technical Coordination: Collaborate with Account Executives and Solutions Engineers to troubleshoot setup concerns (Header Bidding, GAM, wrappers) and ensure optimal configuration.
    • Feature Activation: Ensure all applicable M2 Tech Features are activated at launch to maximize publisher revenue immediately (KPI: Uptake %).
  2. Client-Centric Communication & Education
    • Kick-off & Strategy: Conduct kick-off calls to understand the publisher's specific business goals and align our implementation plan to meet them.
    • Ambassadorship: Act as the primary champion for M2 tools and products. Provide comprehensive walkthroughs to ensure publishers are comfortable and proficient with our platform.
    • Responsive Support: Serve as the primary point of contact for all questions during installation, providing guidance that is both technical and empathetic.
  3. Performance Analysis & Handoff
    • Performance Reviews: Conduct thorough 7-day and 30-day post-live performance reviews. Use data to demonstrate value and identify early optimization wins.
    • Seamless Transition: Manage a structured handoff to the Ad Optimizer and Customer Success Manager, ensuring no momentum is lost after the initial 30-day period.

Day-today Activities

You are the external face of MonetizeMore for our newest partners. You thrive on variety and high-energy interaction—no two days (or publishers) are exactly alike.

  • External Engagement: You will constantly meet new partners, leading high-impact kickoff calls to align our tech with their specific business goals.
  • Project Command: You project manage the entire implementation lifecycle, coordinating between the publisher and our technical teams to ensure an optimal, revenue-ready setup and accelerated scale.
  • Performance Ownership: You don't just "set it and forget it." You conduct data-driven 7-day and 30-day etc. performance reviews to prove value immediately.
  • Seamless Handoff: Once the foundation is solid, you orchestrate a smooth transfer to the account management team ensuring the relationship momentum continues uninterrupted.

How this role fits into the organization

This is a cornerstone role that is pivotal to our company’s success.

  • Strategic Impact: Reporting to the Ad Ops Team Manager, you are the architect of the "First 30 Days." Since our publishers' growth is our growth, our long-term revenue goals effectively start on your desk.
  • The "Wow" Factor: You are responsible for delivering the "White Glove" experience. You set the trajectory for retention by uncovering publisher goals early and proving that MonetizeMore is a partner, not just a vendor.
  • Bridge Builder: You act as the vital link between Sales promises and long-term Operational success, ensuring that every new client enters our ecosystem with clarity, confidence, and a setup primed for revenue generation.

Who You Are

Must Haves

  • Experience: 1+ years of experience in Programmatic sell-side advertising, Customer Onboarding, or Ad Operations.
  • Technical Knowledge: Understanding of Google Ad Manager (GAM), AdSense, Header Bidding, and Google Analytics. Experience with WordPress and debugging ad calls is a strong plus.
  • Analytical Skills: Proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets and data presentation tools. You can spot trends in numbers quickly.
  • Communication: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills. You can command a room (virtually) and manage expectations clearly.
  • Project Management: Demonstrated ability to manage multiple implementations simultaneously without dropping the ball.

Nice to Have

  • Has worked with AdSense, Google Analytics, and GAM and has extensive knowledge of Google policies and other platforms
  • Understands coding and has a strong tech background
  • Has worked with WordPress and is knowledgeable when it comes to implementing ads and debugging ad calls
  • Bilingual - Portuguese and Spanish are an extra bonus

What We Offer

  • Competitive Salary : Our salary formula adjusts to your cost of living and experience.
  • Work remotely : Live and work wherever you like!
  • Flexible working hours : You have the autonomy to set your own schedule
  • Retreats : We meet in person for company get-togethers.
  • Career growth and learning opportunities

The Global Information Technology team plays a strategic role in driving technology and digital transformation across the company. The Data and AI team is responsible for designing, delivering, and evolving technology solutions to improve data usage and drive long-term business results.

This role in summary

We are seeking a skilled Analytics Engineer to join our data team and bridge the gap between raw data and business-ready analytics. This role focuses on designing, building, and maintaining analytics-oriented data models and pipelines, ensuring reliable, well-structured data for dashboards, reports, and advanced analysis. The Analytics Engineer works closely with BI teams, data analysts, data scientists, and business stakeholders, transforming data into trusted analytical assets that support decision‑making.

Your responsibilities will include

Designs and builds analytical data models prioritized by D&A (with support from the Analytics Lead and Data Product Owner);

Develops, tests, and maintains transformation logic (SQL/Dataform) across Silver and Gold layers;

Defines, documents, and maintains business KPIs and semantic definitions (single source of truth);

Performs and documents data validation tests (quality checks, reconciliation, metric validation);

Supports Data Product Owners (BI Teams and Data Science Teams) during UAT and metric validation;

Collaborates with Data Engineers to ensure reliable upstream data ingestion and proper modeling grain;

Supports analytical model deployment through pull requests and downstream validation.

Follows Data Architecture, Semantic Layer standards, and Data Governance policies.

Documents analytical models, business rules, and metric logic (Project documentation & Product documentation – KT);

Partners with BI teams to optimize datasets for reporting tools (Lookerstudio, Tableau, etc.);

Optimizes performance of analytical datasets (aggregations, partitioning strategy alignment, cost awareness);

Supports and trains Analytics/BI teams on new datasets, KPI definitions, and semantic models (KT);

Monitors data freshness, metric consistency, and business logic integrity post‑deployment.

Hands‑on experience designing and maintaining analytical data models in BigQuery (Silver/Gold layers)

Strong proficiency in SQL (BigQuery or similar), including joins, window functions, aggregations, CTEs, and performance‑aware query design;

Strong proficiency in SQL for BigQuery

  • Window functions
  • Aggregations
  • Query performance optimization

Solid understanding of Medallion Architecture (Bronze/Silver/Gold)

  • Fact and dimension tables
  • Surrogate keys
  • Basic Slowly Changing Dimensions (SCD) concepts

Experience implementing data quality validations:

  • Null checks
  • Referential integrity validation

Experience supporting UAT with BI teams and business stakeholders

Working knowledge of Cloud Composer (Airflow) and data dependency orchestration concepts

Understanding of how analytical modeling decisions impact Tableau (or similar BI tools) performance

Proficiency with Git‑based workflows, pull requests, and SQL code reviews

Working knowledge of GCP fundamentals:

  • IAM roles
  • Service accounts
  • Dataset‑level access control
  • Basic cost governance awareness

Ability to document transformation logic, KPI definitions, and business rules following enterprise standards

Preferred skills and experiences

Exposure to Dataflow and Pub/Sub, understanding upstream ingestion patterns

Experience working with SAP (ECC, BW, or S/4) or enterprise ERP systems

Experience with Dataform or structured SQL transformation frameworks

Experience optimizing BigQuery performance, including:

  • Aggregated tables

Exposure to data governance and metric standardization practices

Experience working in large‑scale enterprise environments

Exposure to data observability concepts (freshness monitoring, reconciliation dashboards)

Experience participating in Knowledge Transfer (KT) activities and supporting sustain teams

Professional working proficiency in English (preferred)

Exposure to GenAI‑assisted development tools for SQL or documentation automation

A localização estratégica das unidades da WLM permite uma atuação com ampla cobertura geográfica, garantindo agilidade, qualidade e excelência no atendimento.

title: Customer Success Manager - Remote, Brazil
description:
About Okendo

We believe happy customers make the best marketers.

That’s why we built Okendo – the customer marketing platform that creates stronger connections between consumers and the brands they love.

Using Okendo, Shopify brands can grow faster and more efficiently by cultivating brand advocacy and maximizing lifetime value.

Our unified platform and unique suite of products for Reviews, Referrals, Quizzes, Loyalty, and Surveys is trusted by 16,000+ Shopify brands to turn one‑time shoppers into revenue‑driving Superfans.

Position Summary

As a Customer Success Manager, you will be responsible for delivering value and exceptional customer experience to US‑based customers. You will join a global team of CSMs who are recognized by our merchants as trusted advisors. CSMs at Okendo are accountable for their retention, expansion, and overall customer satisfaction. You will own the successful delivery of our suite of products, while actively pursuing retention and expansion opportunities through constant value demonstration. You will cultivate relationships with merchants and embody our can‑do attitude to meet and exceed their expectations at scale, both through 1:1 touch points and group‑based campaigns. You will be involved in the constant evolution of our processes to maintain our operational excellence and efficiency at scale, within the Customer Success team, and collaboratively with other departments.

How you’ll create impact

  • Own customer retention
    Maintain Net Retention Revenue on assigned accounts
    Be proactive: work with Success team members to own the churn metric by actively taking part in defining and building retention strategies. Proactively respond to churn signals in a timely manner by following SLAs.
    Strengthen automation: help build automated playbooks that will amplify the reach and efficacy of the CSM team.
    Manage outreach campaigns based on Account Health Score and other key signals at important moments of the customer lifecycle.
  • Be a strategic partner to merchants
    Manage accounts: manage an assigned book of business. Adhere to operational standards and SLAs. Focus areas include but are not limited to QBRs, customer emails, onboarding follow‑up, and 90‑day reviews.
    Collaborate across departments: work with the Support team to provide efficient and high‑quality answers to customer inquiries. Work with the Onboarding team to ensure merchants are set up properly on Okendo’s platform, and work with Support Solutions Engineering to proactively detect and resolve issues.
    Drive advocacy and adoption: build strong relationships with merchants by demonstrating product value and by providing exceptional customer service. Drive adoption and education of new features and products.
    Maintain a high personal standard: consistently go above and beyond, not only by providing industry‑leading expertise but also by taking any touchpoint as an opportunity to reinforce the value of Okendo.
  • Source expansion opportunities
    Lead merchant consultations with your assigned accounts.
    You will source and book demos for the Account Management team. Establish yourself as a business partner with merchants, and support expansion initiatives by articulating the value of Okendo’s product suite.
    Drive customer value: ensure successful Onboarding‑CS handoffs to ensure merchants experience growing value from Okendo’s products.
  • Industry, product, and company expertise
    Product expertise: become an expert on Okendo’s product suite and stay up‑to‑date on new products, changes, improvements, and unique merchant use cases.
    Operations: maintain a high operational standard by adhering to SLAs and keeping an eye out for improvement.
    Partner and competitive landscape: understand the merchant tech stack and learn how to leverage partners to effectively build integrated marketing programs.
    Communication: know who, how, and when to work with cross‑functional internal resources (support, onboarding, engineering…) to troubleshoot or optimize accounts.
    Set high standards: work with management to identify areas and implement personal development plans. Maintain awareness of industry trends and bring recommendations to the team. Take ownership of mistakes and celebrate wins with the team.

What we need from you

  • Strong customer‑facing and presentation skills with the ability to establish trust and credibility
  • At least 5 years of experience working in a customer‑facing role at a SaaS company
  • Familiarity with retention and expansion playbooks
  • Comfortable being proactive and pursuing revenue opportunities with the support of the sales team
  • A flexible mindset, willingness to participate in the creation and testing of new processes
  • Ability to work in a high‑volume environment
  • Positive attitude, empathy, and high energy
  • Ability to think through problems and prioritize tasks based on relative importance
  • Impeccable communication, both written and verbal, and presentation
  • A high degree of commitment and resilience as you work to enable the best outcomes for your customer
  • Contributes to a positive team culture by representing company values with your team and external clients
  • Bonus: familiarity with Shopify, Klaviyo, or Google Shopping

What We Value

  • One Team
    We are one team committed to the same mission. We trust, respect, and value each other. We recognize the unique skills, experiences, and perspectives each of us has to offer. We continually look for ways to support and enable our teammates.
  • Champion the customer
    Our customers are the heart of our business and the pursuit of their success is our north star. At every step, we prioritize their interests in our thinking and actions.
  • Strive for excellence
    We commit to excellence as our standard. We set and achieve ambitious goals. We maintain a bias for action, tackle the hard problems, and continually work to improve.
  • Extreme ownership
    We own the outcomes. We take the necessary action to get things done. We don’t blame others or find excuses. We proactively look for solutions and solve problems.
  • Integrity always
    We are always honest, trustworthy, and professional. We treat others fairly and with respect. We are transparent and forthright. We take our commitments seriously and deliver what we promise.
  • Always day one
    It’s always Day 1 at Okendo. If we’re not growing, we’re dying. We prioritize agility over bureaucracy. Velocity over perfection. Outcomes over process. We move fast, learn, iterate, and adapt.

Este profissional terá papel estratégico na condução de projetos, coordenação de squads e evolução contínua de processos e produtos, atuando em um ecossistema já consolidado, com mais de 2.000 clientes ativos e mais de 200.000 usuários .

Será responsável por construção e gerência do time, com visão analítica, capacidade de priorização e forte orientação a resultados, contribuindo para o crescimento sustentável da operação e para o aumento da produtividade do time de desenvolvimento.

REQUISITOS DE GESTÃO E EXECUÇÃO:

  • Experiência comprovada na liderança de times de engenharia (Tech Lead, Coordenação/ Gerência).
  • Atuação com gestão de pessoas: 1:1, feedbacks contínuos e desenvolvimento do time.
  • Capacidade de planejar e garantir execução de projetos, com foco em priorização, prazos, gestão de riscos e remoção de impedimentos.
  • Comunicação clara e eficaz para traduzir temas técnicos e alinhar decisões com áreas de produto e negócio.

REQUISITOS TÉCNICOS:

  • Visão sólida de arquitetura e qualidade de software, com foco em boas práticas, versionamento, code review, testes e gestão de dívida técnica.
  • Experiência com APIs e integrações, especialmente REST.
  • Conhecimento em bancos de dados relacionais e SQL (ex.: PostgreSQL) para apoio a decisões técnicas e diagnósticos.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de gestão e colaboração, como Jira e GitHub.

PERFIL COMPORTAMENTAL ESPERADO:

Buscamos um(a) profissional com liderança orientada a resultados, comunicação clara e capacidade de tomar decisões de forma assertiva. Espera-se um perfil organizado, autônomo e com forte senso de responsabilidade, orientado a processos e à melhoria contínua. Valorizamos a habilidade de atuar e liderar em ambientes dinâmicos, com clareza na comunicação, além de uma mentalidade de produto, sempre com foco na melhor experiência para o cliente.

DIFERENCIAIS DESEJÁVEIS:

  • Experiência em ambientes deautomação/RPA e desenvolvimento de produtos B2B .
  • Vivência emstartups ou scale-ups , atuando em contextos de crescimento acelerado e constante evolução.
  • Atuação na liderança de iniciativas deobservabilidade, monitoramento e definição/acompanhamento de SLAs e SLOs .
  • Conhecimento do stack Java/Spring e/ou frontend (ex.: Angular) , com capacidade de orientar tecnicamente o time e apoiar decisões arquiteturais.
  • Experiência na adoção estruturada de IA no fluxo de desenvolvimento (ex.: Copilot, Cursor ou similares), com mensuração de ganhos de produtividade e qualidade.
  • Forte atuação emgestão orientada a métricas , acompanhando indicadores como lead time, throughput, cycle time, qualidade das entregas, bugs por release e NPS interno.

title: Global Head of Legal & Regulatory (Diretor Global de Jurídico e Regulatório) - São Paulo (Hybrid)
description:
Ready to accelerate your career? Clara is the fastest-growing company in Latin America. We've built the leading solution for companies to make and manage all their payments. We already help over 20,000 large and growing businesses operate with agility and financial clarity through locally issued corporate cards, bill pay, financing, and a powerful B2B platform built for scale.

Clara is backed by some of the most successful investors in the world, including top regional VCs like monashees, Kaszek, and Canary, and leading global funds like Notable Capital, Coatue, DST Global Partners, ICONIQ Growth, General Catalyst, Citi Ventures, SV Angel, Citius, Endeavor Catalyst, and Goldman Sachs - in addition to dozens of angel investors and local family offices. We're building the financial infrastructure that powers high-performing organizations across the region. We invite you to join us if you want to be part of a fast-paced environment that will accelerate your career and support you to do some of the best work of your life alongside a passionate and committed team distributed across the Americas.

What you’ll do

We're looking for a Global Head of Legal & Regulatory to join our executive team and own the legal strategy, regulatory relationships, and team building across all markets where Clara operates. This is Clara's most senior legal position, reporting directly to the CEO. You are not just a legal technician; you are a business leader who happens to be a lawyer—one who makes decisions grounded in data and embraces technology as a force multiplier.

  • Defining Clara's global legal strategy and owning its execution across all markets, anticipating risks before they arise and developing proactive mitigation strategies.
  • Representing Clara in relationships with financial regulators (such as BACEN, CVM, and CNBV), governmental bodies, and relevant industry forums across LatAm.
  • Building and enforcing a compliance framework that scales across multiple jurisdictions, using data to monitor posture in real-time.
  • Building, leading, and developing Clara's in-house legal team—hiring exceptional talent and fostering a culture of urgency, ownership, and commercial judgment.
  • Redesigning how legal services are delivered with a focus on speed and leverage, leading the adoption of AI tools for contract review, research, and workflow automation.
  • Using data to measure the legal team's performance, identifying bottlenecks, and continuously improving function operations.
  • Working closely with Product, Finance, Operations, and Commercial teams to ensure legal is a strategic asset, not a bottleneck.

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Must haves

  • 12+ years of legal experience, with significant time spent in financial services or fintech.
  • Deep expertise in financial regulation across LatAm, with particular fluency in Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia.
  • Experience leading a legal function at a high-growth company, with a proven track record of building and managing high-performing teams.
  • Working proficiency in English and Portuguese.
  • Experience or a strong interest in AI tools to automate legal workflows and increase efficiency.
  • A data-driven mindset: you measure what matters and use data to drive legal and business decisions.
  • Proven ability to navigate regulatory complexity and organizational ambiguity with high ownership.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, acting as a true peer to executive leadership.

Nice to haves

  • Trilingual proficiency (English, Portuguese, and Spanish) or a strong desire to learn Spanish.
  • Independent analytical skills using SQL or spreadsheets to measure team performance metrics.
  • Experience managing external counsel and legal spend via structured reporting or platforms like Hubspot or specialized legal ops tools.
  • A good sense of humor.

Why join Clara

At Clara, you'll have the autonomy, speed, and support to make meaningful impact — not just on your team, but on how organizations are run across Latin America.

Who we are

  • We're the leading B2B fintech for spend management in Latin America.
  • Certified as one of the world's fastest-growing companies, a Great Place to Work, and a LinkedIn Top Startup.
  • Passionate about making Latin America more prosperous and competitive.
  • Constantly innovating to build financial infrastructure that enables each of our customers to thrive.
  • Product-led, high-talent-density culture — designed for builders who raise the bar.
  • Proud of our open, inclusive, and values-driven environment.

What we believe in

  • #Clarity. We say things clearly, directly, and proactively.
  • #Simplicity. We reduce noise to focus on what really matters.
  • #Ownership. We take responsibility and never wait to be told.
  • #Pride. We build products and experiences we're proud of.
  • #Always Be Changing (ABC). We grow through feedback, risk-taking, and action.
  • #Inclusivity. Every voice counts. Everyone contributes to our mission.

What we offer

  • Competitive salary and stock options (ESOP) from day one
  • Multicultural team with daily exposure to Portuguese, Spanish, and English (our corporate language)
  • Annual learning budget and internal accelerated development paths
  • High-ownership environment: we move fast, learn fast, and raise the bar — together
  • Smart, ambitious teammates — low ego, high impact
  • Flexible vacation and hybrid work model focused on results

If you're ready for growth, ownership, and impact — apply now and help us redefine B2B finance in Latin America.

Clara's Hybrid Policy

Claridians in a hybrid mode split their time between working from the office, talking to or visiting customers, or working from home. This hits a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility about how to do this in a way that makes sense for each individual and team. We don't enforce a minimum number of days for most roles, but you're expected to spend time at the office organically, and be at the office most days during your ramp-up or when required by your leader.

title: Director
description:
We are seeking a Director, Programmatic Revenue & Ad Monetization to own the end-to-end programmatic strategy across our digital portfolio. In this highly technical and commercially driven role, you will drive measurable yield and revenue growth by optimizing our existing ad stack (including Prebid and header bidding), owning strategic demand partnerships (SSPs/DSPs), and building scalable monetization frameworks to rapidly integrate future acquisitions.

Success requires a product-first mindset. You will partner closely with product, engineering, and our Data & Decision Science teams to leverage RTB auction mechanics, maximize ad-supported user LTV, and position advertising as a core growth lever across the business.

Employment Type

This is a full-time independent contractor position. We are not currently hiring for direct employee positions.

Location

This is a fully remote position. Work where you perform your best.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define and execute a holistic monetization roadmap to achieve quarterly top-line revenue targets across display, video, and in-app inventory
  • Develop and implement yield strategies—optimizing price floors, Unified Pricing Rules (UPR), and auction dynamics—while running experiments to balance revenue, user engagement, and long‑term LTV
  • Build frameworks that standardize ad-tech operations and enable rapid integration and monetization of newly acquired digital assets
  • Architect and oversee the performance of the programmatic stack, including header bidding wrappers (Prebid, Amazon TAM), mediation platforms, and primary ad servers
  • Oversee SDK integrations and proactively resolve latency, render rate, and revenue leakage issues to ensure smooth delivery at scale
  • Own and negotiate strategic relationships with SSPs, DSPs, exchanges, and agency trading desks to secure premium demand and favorable commercial terms
  • Expand high-value demand channels through the growth of Private Marketplace (PMP) and Programmatic Guaranteed (PG) deals
  • Partner with Data & Decision Science to define KPIs, interpret performance metrics, and translate insights into actionable, revenue‑driving decisions
  • Collaborate with Engineering and Product teams to guide the ad product roadmap, ensuring performance‑optimized and privacy‑compliant placements that maximize monetization.
  • Build, lead, and mentor a high‑performing ad operations and yield team, fostering a culture of rigorous testing, optimization, and operational excellence

Requirements

What You Bring

  • Bachelor’s degree in a technical or analytical field (Computer Science, Economics, Statistics, Engineering, or Business Analytics) or equivalent professional experience
  • 10+ years of professional experience in ad‑tech or digital monetization, including 5+ years in a senior leadership role focused on yield strategy
  • Proven track record of success in owning programmatic revenue for both mobile apps (iOS/Android) and web‑based products, with deep experience in SDK and web‑based implementations
  • Expert‑level technical fluency in the programmatic ecosystem, including RTB mechanics, OpenRTB protocols, unified auctions, and MRAID standards
  • Hands‑on mastery of the modern ad‑tech stack, specifically Ad Servers (e.g., Google Ad Manager), Header Bidding wrappers (e.g., Prebid, Amazon TAM), and mediation platforms (e.g., AppLovin MAX)
  • Deep technical knowledge of demand partners (e.g., Magnite, Index Exchange, PubMatic) and the evolving commercial dynamics of global DSPs
  • Proficiency in high‑level technical QA for ad tags, tracking pixels, and SDK integrations to identify and resolve delivery discrepancies and latency
  • Strong analytical horsepower to interpret complex bid metrics and pricing trends via BI tools; proven ability to partner with Data Science teams to translate LTV modeling and experiments into high‑growth yield strategies
  • Comprehensive knowledge of user privacy frameworks, including GDPR, CCPA, and platform‑specific requirements like Apple’s ATT and Google’s Privacy Sandbox
  • Exceptional problem‑solving and communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear strategic recommendations for executive leadership

Nice to Have (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Master's degree or higher in a quantitative field
  • Advanced understanding of quantitative methods (Statistics, Econometrics, or Computer Science)
  • Success in leading the technical and commercial integration of acquired digital assets within private equity, app aggregator, or technology holding company environments
  • Hands‑on experience with server‑side solutions (e.g., Prebid Server) or a history of contributing to open‑source ad‑tech projects that enhance yield and scalability
  • Proven ability to navigate the unique monetization and brand safety challenges of high‑traffic User‑Generated Content (UGC), chat, or VoIP platforms
  • Specialized knowledge of the browser extension ecosystem, specifically regarding monetization opportunities, ad policies, and technical constraints within the Chrome Web Store
  • A track record of designing and executing complex \"Ad Load vs. Retention\" experiments to identify the optimal balance between aggressive revenue and user engagement
  • Established relationships and active participation in industry leadership groups such as IAB Tech Lab, Prebid.org, or other programmatic working committees
